headline: Godcrofts and Stonecradle Flare While Severe Attrition Grips Inland Fronts
war_summary: Over the past three hours, combat operations have flared across Godcrofts, where six strategic base transitions erupted among the eastern islands, though all nine installations remain under Colonial control at the wire. In Stonecradle, renewed clashes generated three recent base turnovers around World's End, leaving the territory partitioned between four Warden and five Colonial strongholds amid mounting casualties. Stlican Shelf registered two further exchanges, solidifying a seven-to-two Warden majority. Conversely, the intense coastal raids reported earlier in Fisherman's Row and Tempest Island have cooled completely over the past two hours, with no further base transfers logged. Along the interior lines, base captures have temporarily paused in Weathered Expanse, yet the hex endures severe attrition with more than 3,400 casualties over the last two hours. Substantial casualty counts and high enlistment rates persist across Callahan's Passage and Mooring County as well, keeping the northern and central fronts under continuous pressure despite fewer immediate line shifts.
